rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and the provided 3AA grade, but it likely overstates image-specific certainty and includes fine details (exact clock-face ICM location, TE vesicles, perivitelline debris) that may not be reliably visible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, male factor, BMI, first-cycle status, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates broadly matching the favorable profile; minor issues include somewhat speculative effects of stress/alcohol and strong emphasis on a borderline 7 mm lining.

Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer and general prognosis, but includes several adjuncts with limited guideline support (uterine Doppler, routine add-on therapies, ERA/immunologic workup, PGT-A suggestion in a 28-year-old) and overemphasizes some nonstandard interventions.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, luteal support, lifestyle, monitoring, and contingency planning, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard practice.
